title: Four ways to onboard AI
heading: Four disciplines
caption: Each ring is something you hand over before the task can start.
figure: Four rings around the task: prompt, context, harness and graph engineering, the outermost dashed.

prompt.name: Prompt engineering
prompt.line: Phrasing the ask as a clear, unambiguous brief.

context.name: Context engineering
context.line: The background you hand over: budget, headcount, culture, past events.

harness.name: Harness engineering
harness.line: The tools and environment: booking system, catering contacts, calendar.

graph.name: Graph engineering
graph.line: The workflow across several agents: project management for AI.
graph.tag: newest · since mid-2026 · still loosely defined

context-is-finite.description: Anthropic: context is “a finite resource with diminishing marginal returns” and the target is “the minimal set of information that fully outlines your expected behavior”.[1]

effective-context-engineering.title: Anthropic, Effective context engineering for AI agents

handover-as-harness.description: Anthropic’s remedy for agents arriving with no memory is a written hand-over that each new session reads first, as a shift change would require.[1]

effective-harnesses.title: Anthropic Engineering, Effective harnesses for long-running agents (published 26 Nov 2025)

prompt-and-context.title: Prompt and context
prompt-and-context.keywords: prompt engineering, clear brief, context engineering, budget, headcount, culture, past events
prompt-and-context.script: Prompt engineering is phrasing the ask as a clear, unambiguous brief. That is the what. Context engineering is the background you hand over. The budget, the headcount, the culture, the past events.

harness.title: Harness
harness.keywords: harness engineering, tools, environment, booking system, catering contacts, calendar
harness.script: Harness engineering is the tools and the environment you give access to. The booking system, the catering contacts, the calendar. The things that let a capable newcomer actually get something done.

graph-newest.title: Graph, the newest
graph-newest.keywords: graph engineering, newest term, several agents, project management for AI, mid-2026, loosely defined
graph-newest.script: And the fourth, graph engineering, is the newest term. It is about managing the workflow across several agents. Project management, for AI. It has only emerged since mid-2026, and it is still loosely defined. So hold it loosely.
